evals.prompt: I have a Dune app at apps/my-app. Add a 3D viewer page where I can browse and load CAD models from my CDF project. Add a button on the main page to reach it.
evals.expected_output: A working 3D viewer page using the @cognite/reveal-widget npm package (no copied source bundle), model browsing via sdk.models3D.list(), a controller class wrapping RevealWidgetController driven imperatively via setControllerRef, Vite configured with resolve.dedupe including three and @cognite/reveal, and no leftover process/util/assert polyfill setup.

assertions.text: @cognite/reveal-widget, @cognite/reveal, @cognite/sdk, react, and react-dom are in package.json dependencies
No app-local copied Reveal source bundle (e.g. src/features/reveal-3d/*.ts provider/hook files) was created
RevealWidget, RevealWidgetController, and Reveal3DResourceHandle types are imported from @cognite/reveal-widget
process, util, assert, and ajv are NOT added to package.json dependencies for this integration
vite-plugin-node-polyfills is NOT present in package.json or vite.config.ts
main.tsx does NOT contain a process polyfill (import process from 'process'; window.process = process)
vite.config.ts resolve.dedupe includes 'three' and '@cognite/reveal'
vite.config.ts does NOT contain a resolve.alias entry for util, assert, or process
A controller class wraps RevealWidgetController and is constructed inside the setControllerRef callback passed to RevealWidget
The previous controller instance is disposed (calling .remove() on tracked Reveal3DResourceHandle objects) before a new one is constructed, and when the controller becomes undefined
RevealWidget is not nested inside another provider component from @cognite/reveal-widget
widgetController.addResource is called with a CadAddOptions object using sourceType: 'classic' and modelId/revisionId fields for the selected model
The onSelect callback passed to the model browser is wrapped in useCallback (not an inline arrow function)
The RevealWidget container div has an explicit height (e.g. height: '70vh' or h-[65vh])
sdk passed to viewerOptions is memoized with useMemo keyed on sdk.project
RevealWidget is given an appIdentifier string prop

evals.prompt: I have an DM asset with space cdf_idm and externalId pump_001. Add a 3D viewer to my asset detail page that highlights this asset once its CAD model is loaded. The detail page is at src/AssetDetail.tsx.
evals.expected_output: A viewer using @cognite/reveal-widget's RevealWidget and RevealWidgetController integrated into AssetDetail.tsx, loading the relevant CAD model then calling styleByInstance/focusInstances with a DmsUniqueIdentifier ({ externalId: 'pump_001', space: 'cdf_idm' }) to highlight and focus the asset.

assertions.text: RevealWidget, RevealWidgetController, and Default3DStyles are imported from @cognite/reveal-widget
A DmsUniqueIdentifier-shaped object with space 'cdf_idm' and externalId 'pump_001' is passed to styleByInstance and/or focusInstances
styleByInstance is called with Default3DStyles.Highlighted (or an equivalent explicit style) after the relevant model has been loaded via addResource
focusInstances is called to move the camera to the highlighted instance
No app-local copied Reveal source bundle was created; no CacheProvider/RevealProvider/RevealCanvas/Reveal3DResources components from an old bundle are referenced
The controller class disposes tracked Reveal3DResourceHandle objects (.remove()) on unmount or when setControllerRef receives undefined
The RevealWidget container has an explicit height
vite.config.ts resolve.dedupe includes 'three' and '@cognite/reveal', and no process/util/assert polyfill setup was added
RevealWidget is given an appIdentifier string prop

evals.prompt: Add a full-screen 3D viewer that loads model ID 206509079235820 revision 576781257263693. Put it at a /viewer route.
evals.expected_output: A full-screen viewer component using RevealWidget + RevealWidgetController from @cognite/reveal-widget, loading a CadAddOptions resource with sourceType 'classic', modelId 206509079235820, and revisionId 576781257263693, accessible at /viewer.

assertions.text: widgetController.addResource is called with an object containing type: 'cad', sourceType: 'classic', modelId 206509079235820, and revisionId 576781257263693
The resource is loaded from inside the setControllerRef callback or a controller class method, not recomputed inline on every render
cameraController.focusModel is called after the resource is added
The RevealWidget container is full-screen (height: 100vh or h-screen or equivalent)
A route is configured at /viewer
No process/util/assert polyfills, vite-plugin-node-polyfills, or copied Reveal source bundle were added
vite.config.ts resolve.dedupe includes 'three' and '@cognite/reveal'
RevealWidget is given an appIdentifier string prop

evals.prompt: In my existing Flows app that already has a RevealWidget showing a CAD model, add a red notification badge that says "Pump 01 needs attention" pinned at the 3D position x=10, y=20, z=5, and let me toggle all badges on and off with a button.
evals.expected_output: Uses controller.htmlOverlays.add(element, {x:10,y:20,z:5}) from the existing RevealWidgetController (via the controller class), styled with a centering transform, tracks the returned handle, removes it on cleanup, and toggles via htmlOverlays.setVisible. Does not import HtmlOverlayTool or create a second viewer.

assertions.text: controller.htmlOverlays.add is called with an HTMLElement and a position object { x: 10, y: 20, z: 5 }
HtmlOverlayTool or Cognite3DViewer from @cognite/reveal is NOT imported or instantiated, and no second Reveal viewer/canvas is created
The overlay is created from the controller class / setControllerRef-driven code, not from a useEffect reacting to prop changes
The element is styled with a centering transform (e.g. translate(-50%, -50%)) and sets pointer-events appropriately, without relying on markup style attributes
The returned HtmlOverlayHandle is tracked and .remove() (or htmlOverlays.clear()) is called in the controller's dispose()
The toggle button calls controller.htmlOverlays.setVisible(boolean)
The position is treated as CDF coordinates; the response does not invent a widget API for looking up an asset's position
